## Motivation

Make the provenance of the SM121 Qwen3.8 QSA decode kernel point to where it was integrated in this repository, consistent with the other rows of `kda_kernels/README.md`.

## Modifications

- `kda_kernels/README.md`: the provenance column now links [#37500](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37500) (merge commit `52fecfdf09`), like the other rows.
- `qwen38_qsa_sm121/README.md`: the provenance paragraph describes the Kernel Design Agents workflow without external tracker identifiers.
- `qwen38_qsa_sm121/__init__.py`: the fast-path log line drops the external identifiers.
- `qwen38_qsa_sm121/kernel.py`: the source-header comment carrying those identifiers is removed.

Documentation, comments and a log string only; no code path changes.
